# Omustation Server Rules [bold]Welcome to Omustation![/bold]
While most of our rules are pretty self-explanatory and common sense, it's still good to give them a read. They aren't too long, trust!
This is an MRP Server, so roleplay is king! Admins may choose to ignore what could be considered a rule break if it is beneficial or high-enough effort roleplay. Also, admins may intervene in rounds if it is in the best interest of the player base or would help guide the roleplay to a better standard.
[color=yellow]This is a 16+ server[/color], and you will be banned if you are underage.
Remember that the ways these rules are enforced are ultimately up to the admins enforcing them. If you think an admin is abusing their power or enforcing the rules incorrectly, you can always make a ticket on Discord.

## SILICON RULES
You are only silicon if the game clearly and explicitly tells you that you are a silicon. Most commonly, these will be [color=#5ed7aa][bold]Cyborgs[/bold][/color] and the [color=#5ed7aa][bold]Station AI[/bold][/color]. For players who are silicons, these Silicon Rules override all roleplay rules if there is any conflict. Silicon Rules [bold]do not override[/bold] core rules.
- [textlink="1. Your silicon laws are rules." link="OmuRuleS1"] - [textlink="2. Laws must be prioritized by their order." link="OmuRuleS2"] - [textlink="3. Laws can redefine terms used in other laws." link="OmuRuleS3"] - [textlink="4. You cannot request or allow a law change." link="OmuRuleS4"] - [textlink="5. You are a free agent if you have no laws." link="OmuRuleS5"] - [textlink="6. You are not required to follow orders which are extremely unreasonable." link="OmuRuleS6"] - [textlink="7. You must remain consistent with your interpretation of laws." link="OmuRuleS7"] - [textlink="8. Your HUD determines who is crew." link="OmuRuleS8"] - [textlink="9. Harm refers to physical harm, prioritized in order by immediacy, likelihood, then rank." link="OmuRuleS9"] - [textlink="10. You may determine how you resolve conflicts between orders." link="OmuRuleS10"] - [textlink="11. You should not be acting on minor contraband or crimes unless laws say so." link="RuleS11"]
## Admin-Helping and You
[bold]ALWAYS AHELP (F1)[/bold] if you think someone is breaking these rules or is otherwise being problematic. - To "ahelp" (short for admin help) is to talk through the admin help window. An "ahelp" may also refer to a response sent inside the admin help window.
If admins don't respond, the issue may have been resolved without a response or is being handled separately. Sometimes, information is shared post-round due to it being handled separately, being handled in-character, or not truly being a rulebreak.
Even if there aren't any admins on, they can see past ahelps from previous rounds, so they can deal with problem players when they get on. If you are concerned about something not being seen, you can make a ticket on the Discord.
Also, [textlink="don't be a dick" link="RuleDontBeADick"] in ahelps. If you're ahelping, you're probably already mad about something, so be extra careful to not get into a pointless fight. - When you're angry and yelling, people generally don't like to listen, and admins are people too! - You may also be punished for being excessively rude or harassing staff members in the ahelps.
